definitions.meaning: fig. - to touch, affect the mind

quotations.old_english: Ðæt áhrérede mód, ðonne hit ongiet ðæt him mon birgð mid ðǽre gesceádlican andsuare, hit bið getǽsed on ðæt ingeðonc
quotations.latin: commotae mentes, dum et parci sibi sentiunt, et tamen responsorum rations in intimis tanguntur.

source_text: ge-tǽsan. Add: fig. - to touch, affect the mind :-- Ðæt áhrérede mód, ðonne hit ongiet ðæt him mon birgð mid ðǽre gesceádlican andsuare, hit bið getǽsed on ðæt ingeðonc commotae mentes, dum et parci sibi sentiunt, et tamen responsorum rations in intimis tanguntur. Past. 297, 18.
